# Vitals (summon.company)

> A portable company operating dashboard: one config file per company, one zero-dependency renderer, and your AI coding agent as the runtime that keeps it in sync with the codebase.

Vitals gives any repo a founder-fillable "company OS." The codebase is the knowledge base, `vitals.data.js` is the single config and state file (parameters in, state out), and an AI agent reads both to recommend the next moves from first principles. Every metric carries a `next` action, the single move to close the gap, so the dashboard drives decisions that save time, save money, and grow revenue.

It is for founders running one or many projects who want an operating view that lives next to the code, not in a separate SaaS. It installs in one line, has no build step, and works as a static page, a React component, or a vanilla import. It is honest about its stage: an internal tool, dogfooded on real companies, not a polished product yet.

## Key links
- [Home](https://summon.company/): what Vitals is, the install line, and how the AI operating loop works.
- [Live demo](https://summon.company/dashboard.html): summon.company running its own vitals.
- [SKILL.md](https://summon.company/SKILL.md): how an AI agent operates the dashboard, the founder interview, and the commands.
- [schema.md](https://summon.company/schema.md): every field of the config object.
- [Starter config](https://summon.company/vitals.data.example.js): the template you copy and fill.
- [llms-full.txt](https://summon.company/llms-full.txt): the skill, schema, and starter config inlined in one fetch.
